name: @textfilters/url
description: TypeScript URL and obfuscated link detector for content moderation, defanged domains, hxxp links, TLD matching, and safe censoring.

scripts.lint: prettier README.md package.json src docs tests scripts --check
scripts.format: prettier README.md package.json src docs tests scripts --write
scripts.smoke:dist: node --input-type=module --eval "const url = await import('./dist/index.js'); url.createUrlFilter().censor('go to https://example.com');"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:dist && npm run pack:dry-run
